claim: An unlocked legacy paging write remaps MMU slots 0/1 (ROM) and 6/7 and the latest change wins, so map a RAM slot-1 page after the tail's own paging writes; a 128K unlocked write remaps C000-FFFF at once.

evidence.text: Reading of the paging behaviour in the maintainers' notes; not checked against a source file.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite M01): an unlocked 7FFD write set MMU 0 / 1 = $FF and MMU 6 / 7 at once; slots 2-5 kept; a later MMU write won.
